description: This Lua source file defines several utility functions for numeric conversion and bitwise operations, utilizing metatables and metamethods to extend the behavior of strings and numbers.

methods.name: toint
methods.description: Converts a value to an integer if possible, first converting strings to numbers and then to integers; returns false if conversion fails.

methods.name: trymt
methods.description: Attempts to call a metamethod on an operand if it exists, handling errors if the metamethod or operands are not suitable.

methods.name: checkargs
methods.description: Checks if two operands can be converted to integers, attempting metamethod calls if direct conversion is not possible.
